name: cifar100_humans
description: A vision dataset built on CIFAR-100 augmented with human-provided annotations/labels to study model agreement with human judgments on image classification. It is used to evaluate classification models' correspondence to human labeling and to analyze human-model disagreement and uncertainty on CIFAR-100 images. Typically used in research on robustness, calibration, and label noise.
reputation: Niche research dataset extending CIFAR-100 with human annotations; modest adoption for studies of human-model disagreement.
